beats.care: Complained about garbage on Sahaaya with no fix? More inspectors and ward grants aim to change that.
beats.what: The interim report wants 369 junior health inspectors (now 115) and 523 sanitation supervisors (now 198).
beats.why: Many inspectors are outsourced and have limited power over garbage contractors.

cards.body: Up from 198 now, under the panel's interim report.
cards.caption: proposed sanitation-worker supervisors

opts: More inspectors and supervisors with real authority
cards.q: What's the panel's main fix for dirty streets?
cards.why: It wants far more inspectors and supervisors, as outsourced staff have limited power over contractors.

cards.body: This is the first staffing review since BBMP was split into the Greater Bengaluru Authority's corporations a year ago.
cards.title: First review

hook: Why are Bengaluru's *garbage complaints so hard* to fix?

learn.t: Ward grants of up to ₹5 lakh would fund fixes for complaints raised on the Sahaaya platform.

sources.name: Deccan Herald
sources.title: Ex-CS panel seeks more health inspectors, supervisors to keep Bengaluru clean

tldr: A panel led by ex-chief secretary T M Vijay Bhaskar wants Bengaluru's junior health inspectors raised from 115 to 369.
watch: A final report on zonal and corporation-level staff is expected later; no date given.
